title: Retractable Table Tennis Net – 2 Paddles & 6 Balls
descriptionHtml:
A ping-pong table swallows an entire room

Everyone wants to play, but a real table costs thousands and needs space that isn't there. So there's no game.

The net that turns the dining table into a ping-pong table

Clamp the two posts onto any table edge and pull the net out between them — it stretches up to 1.7 meters and covers the whole table. Two paddles and six balls are included, so the match can start right away. When it's time for dinner, you pull the net together and put everything back in the box.

Features

  • Any table becomes a playing field – the net pulls out up to 1.7 m, no tools
  • Everything included to start right away – 2 paddles and 6 balls in the set
  • Leaves no marks – rubber-coated clamps, fit tabletops up to 5 cm
  • Stays firm outdoors too – non-slip rubber base, works as well on the patio as in the kitchen
  • Packed away in seconds – the net is retractable and the whole set fits in the box

Change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
